description: This Rust source file defines functions for converting database query rows into JSON objects, handling various database-specific data types, including ranges, decimals, and binary data. It includes functions for decoding raw database values, normalizing column names, and testing various database type conversions.

methods.name: row_to_json
methods.description: Converts a database row into a JSON object by processing each column and decoding its value.

methods.name: canonical_col_name
methods.description: Normalizes column names, converting uppercase unquoted identifiers to lowercase for ODBC databases.

methods.name: sql_to_json
methods.description: Converts a specific column value from a database row into a JSON value, handling nulls and decoding raw data.

methods.name: decode_raw
methods.description: Decodes a raw database value into a specified type, with error handling and default fallback.

methods.name: decode_pg_range
methods.description: Decodes PostgreSQL range types into JSON string representations.

methods.name: decimal_to_json
methods.description: Converts a BigDecimal to a JSON number, ensuring valid JSON string output.

methods.name: sql_nonnull_to_json
methods.description: Decodes non-null database values into JSON, handling various data types including ranges, decimals, and binary data.

methods.name: row_to_string
methods.description: Converts the first column of a row into a string, or returns None if no columns are present.
